steps.title: Initialize Project Configuration
steps.description: Define the application name 'Modern Calculator Pro' and the unique package identifier 'com.moderncalculatorpro.app'. These will be used consistently throughout the project files.

steps.title: Configure Android Manifest
steps.description: Set up the 'AndroidManifest.xml' file, declaring the application's package, specifying the main activity 'MainActivity', defining the application label 'Modern Calculator Pro', and setting the application icon to '@drawable/icon'.

steps.title: Setup Gradle Build Script
steps.description: Configure 'app/build.gradle' to specify the Android SDK versions (compileSdkVersion 34, targetSdkVersion 34, minSdkVersion 21), build tools version (34.0.0), and the application ID ('com.moderncalculatorpro.app'). Ensure Java 8 compatibility for source and target.

steps.title: Design Main Layout Structure
steps.description: Create the 'activity_main.xml' layout file using a vertical 'LinearLayout' as the root. This will contain a 'TextView' at the top for displaying the calculator input and results, and a 'GridLayout' below it to arrange the calculator buttons.

steps.title: Implement Calculator Display UI
steps.description: Within 'activity_main.xml', design the 'TextView' for showing calculations. Set its ID to 'display_text_view', make its text large and right-aligned, and apply appropriate padding and background for a clean look.

steps.title: Create Number Buttons
steps.description: Add 'Button' widgets for digits 0-9 inside the 'GridLayout' in 'activity_main.xml'. Assign unique IDs (e.g., 'btn_0', 'btn_1') and set their text. Ensure they are arranged in a standard calculator number pad layout.

steps.title: Create Operator Buttons
steps.description: Add 'Button' widgets for common arithmetic operators (+, -, *, /) into the 'GridLayout'. Assign appropriate IDs (e.g., 'btn_add', 'btn_subtract') and text for clear identification.

steps.title: Implement Control Buttons
steps.description: Include 'Button' widgets for 'Clear' (C), 'Delete' (DEL), decimal point (.), and 'Equals' (=) in the 'GridLayout'. Assign IDs (e.g., 'btn_clear', 'btn_del', 'btn_dot', 'btn_equals') and ensure their placement is intuitive.

steps.title: Initialize UI Components in MainActivity
steps.description: In 'MainActivity.java', declare member variables for the 'TextView' (display_text_view) and all 'Button' objects. In the 'onCreate' method, use 'findViewById' to link these variables to their respective UI elements defined in 'activity_main.xml'.

steps.title: Implement Button Click Listeners
steps.description: Attach 'OnClickListener' instances to each calculator button in 'MainActivity.java'. These listeners will be responsible for handling user interactions and triggering the appropriate calculator logic.

steps.title: Develop Number Input Logic
steps.description: Implement the logic within 'MainActivity.java' to handle number and decimal point button presses. This involves appending digits to the current display string, ensuring correct decimal placement, and managing new number entry states.

steps.title: Handle Operator Selection
steps.description: Implement logic in 'MainActivity.java' to process operator button presses. This includes storing the first operand, the selected operator, and preparing for the input of the second operand. If an operation is pending, perform it first.

steps.title: Perform Calculation on Equals
steps.description: Develop the core arithmetic logic in 'MainActivity.java' that executes when the equals button is pressed. This will involve parsing the operands, performing the specified operation, displaying the result, and handling potential errors like division by zero.

steps.title: Implement Clear and Delete Functionality
steps.description: Add the functionality for the 'C' button to reset the entire calculator state (display, operands, operator) and for the 'DEL' button to remove the last character from the display string.

steps.title: Ensure Java 8 Compatibility
steps.description: Verify that all Java source code written in 'MainActivity.java' adheres strictly to Java 8 language features and syntax, avoiding any Java 9+ constructs such as lambdas or streams to ensure compatibility with the build environment.

steps.title: Generate App Metadata
steps.description: Create the 'app-meta.json' file at the project root, containing the 'app_name' and 'package_name' for consistent project identification and management.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator Pro
steps.description: The final step involves compiling and assembling the 'Modern Calculator Pro' application, generating the debug APK ready for installation and testing on an Android device or emulator.
